method: view_image of actual on-disk original and proportional 360/680 PNGs, each at original detail; direct visual inspection, not metadata alone
observedFindings: The left graph contains exactly A→B, B→C and C⊣A.
The right graph contains exactly A→G, A→R and R⊣G; there is no edge returning to A.
Arrowheads, single target inhibition bars, letters and clock remain distinguishable at 360 and 680 widths.
limitations: The graph is a schematic regulatory topology, not a measured kinetic prediction.
Negative feedback and delay do not assert persistent oscillations.
altTextDe: Links führt A zu B, B zu C und C hemmt A: eine geschlossene Rückkopplung. Rechts führt A zu G und verzögert zu R; R hemmt G, ohne Rückkante zu A.
altTextEn: At left, A activates B, B activates C and C inhibits A, forming a feedback loop. At right, A activates G and activates R with a delay; R inhibits G, with no return edge to A.
